name: Financial Instrument Reporting Equity Transparency Data Report V 01
definition: The FinancialInstrumentReportingEquityTransparencyDataReport message is sent by the trading venues to the national competent authority to report on the transparency data for equity financial instruments.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header information related to the global report, common to all reference data.

EquityTransparencyData.name: Equity Transparency Data
EquityTransparencyData.definition: Details the equity transparency qualitative data reported by a trading venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
